questions.question: Differentiate between real and virtual optical images.
questions.correct_answer: Real images are formed by actual intersecting rays and caught on screens. Virtual images are formed by apparent ray extensions and cannot be caught on screens.
questions.hint_modal: Hint for Chapter 10: Focus on fundamental definitions and experimental observations.

questions.question: Explain how a concave parabolic mirror functions as a solar concentrator for cooking.
questions.correct_answer: A concave reflector reflects parallel incoming sunlight beams toward a single focal point. Concentrating solar radiation at this focal point generates intense thermal heat capable of cooking food.

questions.question: Describe image changes as an object moves from far away toward a concave mirror.
questions.correct_answer: 1. Object beyond C: Real, inverted, diminished image formed between F and C. 2. Object at C: Real, inverted image of equal size at C. 3. Object between C and F: Real, inverted, magnified image beyond C. 4. Object at F: Real, inverted image at infinity. 5. Object inside F: Virtual, erect, magnified image formed behind the mirror.
